anchors.reason: The abstract explicitly states, 'This dataset contains event-related potential (ERP) data from a picture naming task,' directly describing the data contained in this release.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 electrodes (left mastoid reference) at 500 Hz sampling rate with DC to 200 Hz bandpass filtering. Participants performed a picture naming task in which 100 unique line drawings (50 semantic, 50 identity category) were each presented twice, preceded by either semantically related, identity-related, or unrelated English distractor words (200 ms duration, 2000 ms inter-stimulus interval). Voice responses were digitized online and event markers were synchronized with EEG data for ERP averaging.
